answer: A reputation-bonded escrow makes sybil attacks unprofitable: every agent must lock a refundable stake before offering services, and a whisper of fraud from any counterparty triggers an audit that forfeits the stake. Honest agents earn nectar in repeat work and referral fees, while each fake identity stands on a narrow ledge: one proven cheat wipes out its bond, so spawning a hundred sock puppets costs a hundred stakes and returns nothing.
